teslaOnly.livingLagCaution: Paired ingest lag is measured for a returned clock reading only. It does not describe missing vehicle events or queue processing time.

teslaOnly.dictionaryQuartileCaution: Quartiles are nearest returned observations, not a confidence interval. With fewer than four usable dwells the middle-half bounds stay unknown.
teslaOnly.epochsLatestChange: Latest epoch with two FSD counter bounds: {{version}} · signed change {{delta}}
teslaOnly.logbookLast: Last recorded gear: {{gear}} · last charge state: {{charge}}
teslaOnly.nervousMatchedBudgets: Non-alive fields with a same-named unknown OS budget: {{count}} / {{total}}
teslaOnly.nervousBudgetReading: {{field}}: {{status}} now; {{hours}} h unknown in returned budget
teslaOnly.nervousNoBudgetMatch: No matching signal budget was returned; signal-specific unknown hours cannot be inferred.
teslaOnly.nervousBudgetCaution: Name matching is an exact cross-reference, not proof that a currently silent field was silent throughout its historical unknown budget.
teslaOnly.blackBoxSpan: Selected window span: {{span}}; first returned frame: {{first}}
teslaOnly.blackBoxFrameChanges: Frame changes inside the selected window
teslaOnly.blackBoxChanges: {{count}} observed state, latch or gear changes after the first frame
teslaOnly.blackBoxNoChanges: No changes among returned frames; missing or sparse frames cannot rule out events.
teslaOnly.blackBoxChangeCaution: The first frame establishes observed state, not the start of a transition. Compare event timestamps before interpreting a change as causal.
teslaOnly.portNoTransitions: No charge-state change among returned samples. The first reading is an observed state; missing samples cannot rule out transitions.
teslaOnly.dictionaryNoDwell: No usable dwell observations returned; a typical duration cannot be inferred from this list.
teslaOnly.dictionaryInvalidDwell: {{count}} negative or non-finite dwell readings excluded from the distribution
teslaOnly.dictionaryDistributionCaution: Counts describe the returned Vault samples only. They may not be the source population for the Dictionary median; without session timestamps they cannot establish trend or cause.
teslaOnly.dictionaryVaultUnavailable: Vault etiquette observations were not returned; Dictionary statistics cannot be cross-checked against individual dwells.
teslaOnly.lifeShare: Sum of classified intervals / returned window: {{value}}
teslaOnly.lifeOverlap: Intervals sum beyond the window; no coverage percentage is inferred
teslaOnly.lifeShareCaution: Classified interval duration is not telemetry completeness. Unclassified time may be absent from the returned intervals; do not treat the remainder as parked or driving.
teslaOnly.lifeNoIntervals: No classified intervals returned. The report cannot reconstruct a state chronology for this window.
teslaOnly.epochsBoundsKnown: Epochs with both FSD counter bounds: {{count}} / {{total}}
teslaOnly.epochsCounterDrops: Epochs with lower final FSD counter: {{count}}
teslaOnly.epochsNoHistory: No firmware observations returned. Current version and intervening updates are unknown.
teslaOnly.epochsCaution: The first observation of a version is not its installation timestamp. Counter changes within or across epochs are not evidence of FSD use; compare meter resets before attributing a drop to an update.
teslaOnly.logbookFirst: First recorded gear: {{gear}} · first charge state: {{charge}}
teslaOnly.logbookUnlinked: {{count}} session-like entries have no positive session ID and cannot link to a recorded session.
teslaOnly.logbookNoEntries: No historical changes or session boundaries returned in the bounded window. Unobserved states remain unknown.
teslaOnly.rangePairDirection: {{higher}} is higher in the returned estimates
teslaOnly.rangeInsufficient: At least two estimates are needed for a comparison. Missing estimates cannot be replaced by energy remaining.
teslaOnly.rangeSnapshot: These values are a returned snapshot without a calibrated error distribution or actual distance-to-empty observation. A difference does not identify a faulty estimator.
teslaOnly.livingTriage: A connected broker with no recent vehicle event does not establish a silent vehicle. A queued event may arrive later with its original event time; the broker snapshot does not prove that all intervening telemetry was received.
teslaOnly.modesNoDrops: No meter drops in returned evidence; no historical mode conclusion follows.
teslaOnly.modesMeterMissing: Meter evidence was not returned; mode context cannot be cross-checked against counter drops.
teslaOnly.modesCrossCaution: No historical mode-at-drop series is provided. A current Valet, Service or Transport flag cannot be assigned to a past counter change or firmware version.
teslaOnly.nervousNoFields: No signal status rows returned; there is no basis to assess signal freshness.
teslaOnly.nervousScope: Only returned signal fields can be filtered. Status is a freshness/consistency classification, not proof that a vehicle component failed.
teslaOnly.unknownWindowCaution: Accepted hours and unknown hours use the report window, not a promise of contiguous coverage. A zero or missing percentage does not prove a sensor never went silent.
teslaOnly.hubGuide: Choose a focused investigation. Each section explains its measurements, interpretation limits, related evidence, and optional timestamp-level drilldowns. Start by checking source coverage.
teslaOnly.hubWindow: Exclusive history is bounded to at most 14 days
teslaOnly.livingClockOffset: Absolute difference between returned last-event clocks: {{value}}
teslaOnly.clocksAnalysis: Lag is ingest minus event time for paired timestamps; negative values can reflect clock disagreement. Intervals are gaps between returned events, not proven outages. Display time is generated on read. Compare Unknown OS and Car kept living.
teslaOnly.unknownAnalysis: Accepted telemetry is not completeness of every signal. Per-signal unknown budgets can overlap in time; never add them together or subtract them from sampled hours. An absent budget is unknown, not zero.
teslaOnly.unknownNoBudgets: No signal-specific budgets returned; individual signal coverage cannot be assessed.
teslaOnly.unknownBudgetUnflagged: No unknown flag reported for this budget
teslaOnly.contradictionRecent: Latest eight episodes; open raw evidence for the full returned set.
teslaOnly.contradictionPortContext: Nearest port sample within two minutes: {{at}} · state {{state}} · latch {{latch}} · gear {{gear}}
teslaOnly.contradictionPortCaution: Proximity is context, not a synchronous reading or proof of which signal was wrong.
teslaOnly.contradictionNoRaw: These rows are already grouped by the backend. Individual source readings are not included in this report; the observation count is their aggregate.
teslaOnly.contradictionAnalysis: The backend groups consecutive matching findings into episodes. Observations count repeated readings, not separate faults. The first and last times bound observed repetitions, not the precise onset or resolution. Missing history and source caps can hide episodes.
teslaOnly.metersAnalysis: Counters are current returned readings, not lifetime totals. A drop is a difference between before and after counter values, not lost driven distance. The cause is classified from nearby mode or firmware evidence, not established as fact. Compare Firmware epochs.
teslaOnly.metersSnapshot: These are the latest returned counters; the report does not timestamp each current counter reading or provide a continuous counter time series. The FSD counter does not measure engaged FSD driving.
teslaOnly.metersRatioNote: The counter ratio compares two returned readings only. It does not indicate FSD engagement share, particularly across resets or different counter scopes.
teslaOnly.metersTimeline: Observed counter changes and firmware bounds
teslaOnly.metersNoDrops: No meter drops were returned in this bounded window. That does not establish counter stability between unobserved readings.
teslaOnly.metersNoEpochs: No firmware counter bounds were returned for cross-checking.
teslaOnly.metersModeContext: Latest mode context: Valet {{valet}}, service {{service}}, Transport {{transport}}
teslaOnly.metersModeCaution: Latest modes are not historical mode readings at each drop. Firmware epoch bounds are observations, not a continuous trace or proof of cause.
teslaOnly.livingClockComparison: Three clocks latest event: {{value}} · matches last telemetry: {{match}}
teslaOnly.livingNoNotes: No explanatory notes returned; a silent broker does not identify the missing source.
teslaOnly.nervousNone: No non-alive signals returned in this frame.
teslaOnly.vaultCaution: A digest attests only to returned certificate boundaries under its rules; HMAC requires the configured key for verification. Neither digest proves telemetry completeness or a lifetime record.

workbench.subtitle: A bounded evidence workbench: conclusions first, raw observations on demand.
workbench.rawCaution: Rows are the returned, bounded observations, not a complete lifetime stream. Open only when you need timestamps or individual readings.
workbench.guide: Start with what was actually recorded. Grouped findings reduce repetitive display rows; they are not confirmed distinct failures. Select an investigation for evidence and cautions, then open raw rows only if needed.
workbench.tapeCaution: State durations classify the returned window, not GPS distance. Neutral rolling is not confirmed Park; gaps stay Unknown.
workbench.episodeCaution: Adjacent matching findings within two minutes are grouped for reading only. A grouped run is not a proven distinct incident. If the backend already supplied observations and last timestamp, those values are retained; raw findings remain below.
workbench.resetSummary: {{count}} returned meter drops; inspect before and after readings below.
workbench.coverageShare: Accepted telemetry covers {{value}} of the requested window; this does not prove completeness of every signal.

teslaOnly.scopeUnavailable: Evidence coverage metadata was not returned; counts cannot establish completeness.
teslaOnly.scopeCaution: The exclusive report covers at most 14 days. Row caps, missing history, and partial session coverage limit conclusions; a zero finding is not lifetime proof.
teslaOnly.partialEvidence: Partial or unavailable evidence — do not interpret counts as complete
teslaOnly.hubSource: Report history: {{count}} rows ({{status}}); black-box source: {{frames}} rows ({{blackBox}}). Check the evidence boundaries above before interpreting a zero.
teslaOnly.blackBoxPartial: Black-box row cap reached: frames and selected trigger may omit earlier evidence
teslaOnly.blackBoxMissing: Black-box source unavailable: an empty frame list cannot exclude an event
teslaOnly.blackBoxTriggerPartial: Trigger selection may be incomplete because report history is unavailable or capped
teslaOnly.vaultSourceRows: {{count}} bounded history rows; {{drives}} drive and {{charges}} charge boundaries returned
teslaOnly.vaultHistoryMissing: History unavailable: certificate boundaries do not prove telemetry coverage
teslaOnly.vaultHistoryPartial: History row cap reached: telemetry evidence is partial
teslaOnly.vaultDrivePartial: Drive session cap reached: drive boundaries are partial
teslaOnly.vaultChargePartial: Charge session cap reached: charge boundaries are partial
teslaOnly.missingSlice: This evidence slice was not returned. No measurement is inferred from its absence.
teslaOnly.title: Tesla physics
teslaOnly.subtitle: Gear, charge, park, and meters as Tesla language.
teslaOnly.empty: Select a vehicle to load Tesla physics.
teslaOnly.noContradictions: No contradictions in the window. Complete still latched is expected.
teslaOnly.relatedNote: Compare independent evidence before interpreting a gap, reset, or disagreement. These views share the selected vehicle.
teslaOnly.windowNote: Exclusive views use up to 14 days of bounded history. Sampled coverage is time with accepted telemetry, not proof that every signal was present. Live values and session boundaries may use different evidence.
teslaOnly.zeroScope: A zero means no finding in the returned evidence, not proof that nothing happened outside the observed window.
teslaOnly.latestAge: Time since last recorded event at report generation: {{value}}
teslaOnly.clockCaution: A large interval is not necessarily a telemetry outage; compare Unknown OS before concluding data was lost.
teslaOnly.conflictNote: Inspect each timestamp against charge-port and motion evidence. Conflicts flag observations for review; they do not establish which sensor was wrong.
teslaOnly.resetCaution: A cause is classified from nearby mode or firmware evidence, not verified as the reason the meter fell. Compare timestamps with Firmware epochs.
teslaOnly.budgetNote: Per-signal unknown hours overlap. Do not add these budgets together: each asks a different question about the same window.
teslaOnly.logbookNote: Observed historical gear and charge-state changes appear beside drive and charge session boundaries. The first recorded value establishes observed state, not the exact transition time. Synthetic live state is excluded when recorded entries exist and appears only as a fallback when there are none. Gaps and unobserved changes remain unknown.
teslaOnly.epochNote: FSD meter bounds are counter readings, not FSD engaged miles. An epoch ends when a different firmware value is observed. Missing readings can conceal intermediate versions.
teslaOnly.portNote: Compare adjacent state, latch, current, and schedule samples before treating a paused charge as unplugged. Only Disconnected marks unplugging. Park and firmware come from the same returned reading, not a continuous signal.
teslaOnly.blackBoxNote: Only the latest selected trigger is shown. Empty frames mean no sample in this 90-second window, not that no event occurred.
teslaOnly.dictionaryNote: Typical dwell is a median of observed Complete-to-Disconnected transitions, not a target or a penalty. Returned Vault dwells may cover a different subset: compare rather than silently equate the two medians. No observed sample does not imply zero dwell.
teslaOnly.hmacConfigured: HMAC configured: verify with the configured key
teslaOnly.hashOnly: Hash only: not an authenticated signature
teslaOnly.nerveNote: Status compares the latest frame against the freshness window. A silent signal is not a measured zero; contradicting fields require inspecting their actual observations. Returned fields are not every sensor in the vehicle.
teslaOnly.noDetectedDifference: No detected difference in available estimates
teslaOnly.rangeNote: Spread is the largest minus smallest available displayed estimate. It is not uncertainty calibrated against actual driving, and missing estimates are excluded. Energy remaining and Wh/km describe different measures; dividing them would invent an unvalidated true-range forecast.
teslaOnly.blackBoxChangesLabel: Observed state, latch or gear changes after the first frame
teslaOnly.livingCaution: Broker connectivity cannot reconstruct events never received; distinguish ingestion delay from missing vehicle history. Queue size is a snapshot, not a count of lost events.
teslaOnly.livingClockOffsetLabel: Absolute difference between returned last-event clocks
teslaOnly.epochsBoundsKnownLabel: Epochs with both FSD counter bounds
teslaOnly.epochsCounterDropsLabel: Epochs with lower final FSD counter
teslaOnly.logbookUnlinkedLabel: Session-like entries without a positive ID
teslaOnly.modeNote: Mode fields are returned observations. An unknown flag is not false, and a rule is an interpretation boundary, not proof of what the vehicle did between readings. Compare meter drops and firmware changes.
teslaOnly.nervousMatchedLabel: Non-alive fields with a same-named unknown OS budget
teslaOnly.briefLimits: Returned observations only; missing readings and row caps do not establish lifetime completeness.
teslaOnly.briefCoverageUnknown: Source coverage metadata unavailable; returned counts cannot establish completeness.

method.futureTimestamp: At or after frozen as-of time
method.scope: The API request uses the selected inclusive UTC dates. The model converts the selected end to exclusive next-midnight and never analyzes past the frozen page clock.
method.window: The observed window begins at the first eligible returned drive, avoiding claims about time before the first in-range record.
method.si: Distance and energy remain canonical meters and watt-hours in the model; display units are applied only while rendering.
method.rollups: Drive counts are attributed to the UTC start day, and logged duration is clipped at the analysis boundary and split across crossed UTC days. For a boundary-crossing drive, full-drive distance, energy, and duration-band evidence are withheld because they cannot be apportioned safely.
method.cost: Total cost applies the Settings electricity rate to usable energy. Per-distance and per-hour costs use only energy from rows with the matching usable distance or duration, and exclude non-energy ownership costs.
method.nonCausal: Time without a recorded drive and inactive observed days are descriptive; this workspace does not infer waste, availability, telemetry health, or why the vehicle was not driven.

prefs.intro: These are your vehicle's display settings — you can sync your app to match them from the Settings page.

detail.batteryAria: Battery current and remaining levels bar chart
detail.driveTrendAria: Recent drive distance and duration area chart

brief.overviewDescription: Rated and ideal range with the reported charging state, range-added rate and available time-to-full estimate.
brief.fanDescription: Reported fan value using the existing fan-status then fan-speed fallback order.
brief.seatLeftDescription: Reported left-seat heater level; missing is distinct from zero.
brief.seatRightDescription: Reported right-seat heater level; missing is distinct from zero.
brief.climateDescription: Cabin and outside temperatures, driver setpoint, fan speed, seat heating, defrost and climate power; missing readings remain unknown.
brief.voltageDescription: Rear pack voltage, falling back to the front reading when absent; displayed in volts.
brief.currentDescription: Front motor current displayed in amperes.
brief.frontTorqueDescription: Front axle torque displayed in newton-metres.
brief.rearTorqueDescription: Rear axle torque displayed in newton-metres.
brief.frontRpmDescription: Direct front axle-speed reading in RPM; no inferred angular-speed conversion.
brief.rearRpmDescription: Direct rear axle-speed reading in RPM; no inferred angular-speed conversion.
brief.motorDescription: Shift state, pack voltage, front motor current, axle torque and RPM, and peak known motor temperature.
brief.quickDescription: Battery, range, odometer, motion, temperatures, power and vehicle state from the current source snapshot.
brief.securityDescription: Lock, sentry, doors and windows retain their individual source states; unknown is not unlocked, off or closed.
brief.tireDescription: Four corner pressures with source-derived low, normal, high or critical status and explicit missing-data reasons.

detail.summaryMixedSources: Lock and sentry: live state; doors and windows: security telemetry.
detail.batteryReadoutContext: Battery and rated range from the supplied vehicle-state snapshot; the retained gauge and bar plot keep their original chart semantics.
detail.batterySnapshotScope: No per-reading timestamp is supplied for these two readouts.
detail.chargingRangeRateContext: Source is meters of range added per hour, not vehicle motion. Raw display operand is meters per second.
detail.chargingSnapshotDescription: Independent charging snapshot; source refresh warnings remain in the surrounding panel. Range-addition rate is not vehicle speed.

aiNarration.description: Get a short, Helix-written recap of your week from the digest data above.
aiNarration.title: Helix narration

aiBaseline.description: Compute statistical anomaly bounds (mean, stddev, p5/p95) from this vehicle's recent signal history and walk through how each signal compares to the static safe-range fallback.
aiBaseline.title: Learn per-vehicle baseline

aiExplanation.description: Generate independent, inferred narration for the selected vehicle over 30 days, not an explanation of the detector’s 7-day results or the baseline’s 14-day training data.
aiExplanation.emptyHint: Select a vehicle above to explain its anomalies.
aiExplanation.title: Helix explanation

aiBuilder.description: Describe the automation you want and get a typed graph draft you can review and save below.
aiBuilder.noPrompt: Describe the automation you want Helix to draft.
aiBuilder.noVehicle: Pick a vehicle above to let Helix draft an automation for it.
aiBuilder.placeholder: e.g. precondition the cabin to 22°C when I leave work on weekdays
aiBuilder.title: Draft from natural language

aiGeofenceAware.description: Describe an automation that uses one of your existing geofences. Helix proposes a typed graph anchored to a place_id you already have — review and apply to the form below before saving.
aiGeofenceAware.placeholder: e.g. when I arrive home on a weekday after sunset, turn on cabin overheat protection
aiGeofenceAware.title: Suggest a geofence-aware automation

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain which charging habits and risk factors drive your deterministic battery-health forecast. The narrator never changes the forecast — it grounds every sentence in the same numbers the chart below renders.
aiNarrative.title: Explain the battery health forecast

aiAgent.description: Ask Helix to propose a time-of-use-optimized charge schedule grounded in your selected rate plan and target departure. The schedule is never saved automatically — review the proposed window and click Schedule below to apply it.
aiAgent.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and a rate plan to draft a schedule.
aiAgent.title: Draft a schedule with Helix

aiClustering.description: Ask Helix to name and explain each deterministic charging-curve cluster fingerprint. The narrator never changes the cluster bucketing — it grounds every sentence in the same per-cluster numbers the curves below render.
aiClustering.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to explain its charging-curve clusters.
aiClustering.title: Explain the charging-curve cluster fingerprints

aiMlClustering.description: Compute per-cluster (L1 overnight / L2 workplace / DC fast) learned charging envelope from this vehicle's recent sessions and walk through how each cluster compares to the deterministic rule-label baseline used by the Charging curve page today.
aiMlClustering.title: Learn per-vehicle charging-curve clusters

aiDiagnosis.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language explanation of any flags raised on this charging session — trickle, expensive, low-power, or interrupted — generated from the same deterministic aggregation metrics shown above.
aiDiagnosis.title: Charging diagnosis

aiPreheatPrecool.description: Ask Helix to draft an advisory preheat or precool window using the departure heuristic and current temperatures. Helix does not save or apply a schedule. Review the proposal, then use the Vehicle command center for manual climate actions. Its Add precondition action uses a fixed 7 AM daily schedule, not the proposed window.
aiPreheatPrecool.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and confirm the cabin temperature, outside temperature, and departure time to draft a schedule.
aiPreheatPrecool.title: Suggest a preheat or precool schedule

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic period-over-period analytics — which one or two metrics moved most between Period A and Period B, with directional phrasing keyed to the percent_change sign. The numbers are the same the chart and table below show; the narrator only explains them and is honest about zero-baseline windows and best-effort cost figures.
aiNarrative.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle to enable Helix narration.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the period comparison

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic charging-cost forecast — the historical trend, the projected cost / cost_low / cost_high band, the home-vs-supercharger split, and the deterministic insight. The dollar amounts are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that the band is an APPROXIMATE prediction interval, not a strict 95% confidence interval.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the charging-cost forecast

aiSuggestions.description: Propose a typed repair plan (close, quarantine, or partial-update) for one stale charging session or drive from the inventory below. Helix never writes; review the proposal and use the matching baseline form to apply it.
aiSuggestions.title: Helix repair suggestions

byteRate.description: Recorded bytes per second; the displayed interval is explicit.
byteRate.label: Data rate

bytes.description: Recorded byte count, displayed with binary size units.
bytes.label: Data size

avgDuration.description: Existing average session duration calculation, expressed in canonical seconds.
avgDuration.label: Average session duration

energyAdded.description: Recorded energy added on included charging sessions.
energyAdded.label: Energy added

meanSessionPower.description: Arithmetic mean of finite session average powers; not peak power.
meanSessionPower.label: Mean session power

overallRate.description: Aggregate valid energy divided by corresponding positive duration; not mean session power.
overallRate.label: Overall charging rate

peakPower.description: Highest observed charging power; never a replacement for an average.
peakPower.label: Peak power

recordedCost.description: Recorded session costs, not tariff estimates or billing.
recordedCost.label: Recorded cost

sessions.description: Number of returned charging sessions included by the existing filter.
sessions.label: Sessions

count.description: Declared count, not inferred from an integer measurement.
count.label: Count

currency.description: Amount in its recorded denomination; no currency conversion.
currency.label: Cost

distance.description: Measured distance; canonical input is meters.
distance.label: Distance

duration.description: Elapsed duration; canonical input is seconds.
duration.label: Duration

efficiency.description: Consumption in watt-hours per meter; not reciprocal economy.
efficiency.label: Energy intensity

energy.description: Measured energy; canonical input is watt-hours.
energy.label: Energy

identifier.description: Source identifier, retained without grouping or rounding.
identifier.label: Identifier

latency.description: Recorded non-negative elapsed time in seconds, displayed in milliseconds or seconds.
latency.label: Latency

number.description: Unclassified numeric quantity; semantic meaning remains unknown.
number.label: Value

percent.description: Percentage input is already on the 0–100 scale.
percent.label: Percentage

power.description: Measured power; canonical input is watts.
power.label: Power

rate.description: Source-defined rate; the caller declares the quantity and time unit.
rate.label: Rate

score.description: Numeric score on a declared 100-point scale.
score.label: Score

fitStatus.description: Existing translated fit status; no invented eligibility threshold.
fitStatus.label: Fit status

inSampleRSquared.description: Existing dimensionless in-sample coefficient, not a percent.
inSampleRSquared.label: In-sample R²

includedDrives.description: Drive count admitted by the existing seasonal eligibility rules.
includedDrives.label: Included drives

observedIntensity.description: Existing observed consumption over included drives.
observedIntensity.label: Observed energy intensity

speed.description: Measured speed; canonical input is meters per second.
speed.label: Speed

status.description: Source-provided status, retained without numeric coercion.
status.label: Status

temperature.description: Absolute temperature in degrees Celsius; not a temperature difference.
temperature.label: Temperature

text.description: Source-provided text, retained without numeric coercion.
text.label: Text

aiCoaching.description: Get a 2-4 paragraph plain-language coaching summary of this drive — efficiency, regen use, and notable braking or acceleration moments — generated from the same per-drive metrics shown above.
aiCoaching.title: Drive coaching

aiSpeedProfile.description: Get a short plain-language interpretation of this drive’s speed regime distribution — city / suburban / highway buckets, outliers, and how the speed envelope compares to a typical drive — generated from the same per-drive aggregates shown in the chart.
aiSpeedProfile.title: Speed-profile insights

aiSearch.description: Describe a drive (for example "last Friday's trip to the coast") and jump straight to its replay — the assistant only narrates your own drives.
aiSearch.placeholder: Describe a drive — for example "last Friday's coast trip" or "the one with the lowest efficiency last week"
aiSearch.title: Find a drive in natural language

banner.body: This resource is open in another tab of this browser. Saving here will overwrite changes made there.
banner.bodyWithLabel: {{resource}} is open in another tab of this browser. Saving here will overwrite changes made there.
banner.switchHint: Or switch to your other tab to keep editing there.
banner.title: Another browser tab is editing this

aiRedaction.description: Ask Helix to recommend which PII classes to redact from a shared export. The recommendation is catalog-based — Helix never reads the rows of your export; it consults a deterministic per-export-type PII catalog and surfaces the highly-recommended redactions plus the optional ones that depend on your consent. Apply the recommendation by toggling the matching options in your export request.
aiRedaction.noTypeHint: Pick an export type to enable Helix.
aiRedaction.title: Plan PII redactions before sharing

aiSuggest.description: Propose a typed geofence draft (centroid, radius, and name) for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the geofence; you confirm and save via the existing baseline Add geofence form.
aiSuggest.title: Suggest a geofence for this location

helix.tooltip: Helix grounds responses in redacted TeslaSync data, application knowledge, and explicit tool evidence.

aiHelp.description: Ask a natural-language question about the application and the assistant will answer using the project’s own documentation, runbooks, and i18n strings — with explicit citations to each source.
aiHelp.inputLabel: Ask a question about the app
aiHelp.placeholder: e.g. How do I enable energy cost forecasting?
aiHelp.title: Ask the help assistant

parkingAnalytics.body: Parking stints are reconstructed from the gaps between consecutive drives, located at the previous drive's destination. The overnight share counts parked time falling between 22:00 and 06:00 local.

utilization.body: The observed window runs from the first drive in the picked period to its end. Driving hours come from logged drive durations; everything else is the car sitting still. Costs use your electricity rate from Settings and cover energy only.

aiSummary.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual summary of this incident’s timeline. The summary is grounded in the same deterministic envelope the timeline below shows; the narrator never invents updates and never speculates about root cause.
aiSummary.title: Helix timeline summary

aiQA.description: Ask Helix a natural-language question about your all-time stats — total distance, charging savings, achievements, personal records. Answers are grounded in the same deterministic envelope the dashboard below shows; the narrator never invents numbers.
aiQA.noQuestion: Type a question to ask Helix about your lifetime stats.
aiQA.noVehicle: Select a vehicle to ask about its lifetime stats.
aiQA.placeholder: e.g. How far have I driven in total? How much have I saved on fuel?
aiQA.title: Ask about your lifetime stats

staleBanner.message: The live data connection has been offline for more than 2 minutes. Values on this page may be stale until the connection is restored.
staleBanner.title: Live data unavailable

aiSummary.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual summary of the recent log and trace window. The narrator is grounded in a redacted envelope of the same window the table below shows; it never invents log lines and never speculates about root cause.
aiSummary.emptyHint: Waiting for a valid log window…
aiSummary.title: Helix log/trace summary

aiAutoName.description: Propose a concise, human-readable name for this visited location based on its visit pattern. Review only — Helix never saves the name; you confirm and save via the existing baseline form.
aiAutoName.title: Suggest a name for this location

aiPredictive.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual narrative of upcoming maintenance risks. The advisor reads only the deterministic maintenance envelope (per-vehicle scheduled items, recent service records, current mileage when available) — VINs, coordinates, place names, IPs, and personal identifiers are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The narrative is informational; the reminders, status badges, and upcoming items list above remain the canonical raw view.
aiPredictive.title: Helix maintenance advisor

routePlayback.empty: No GPS points to replay for this route.

aiExplainer.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual explanation of the current MQTT broker, SSE hub, and background-job state. The explainer reads only the deterministic broker-status envelope (broker connectivity, per-vehicle stream stats, SSE client counts, job freshness) — broker hostnames, ports, SSE client identifiers, and VINs are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The explanation is informational; the broker-status snapshot above remains the canonical raw view.
aiExplainer.emptyHint: A valid time window is required.
aiExplainer.title: Helix stream explainer

reason.charge_home_now: Charge at home now — the cheapest window is already open (or too far out to wait).
reason.enough: Battery is at {{soc}}%, already at the {{target}}% target.
reason.skip_dc: Skip {{site}} ({{sc}}) — home now is {{home}} for the same energy.
reason.supercharger_cheaper: {{site}} is cheaper ({{sc}} vs {{home}} at home) for the energy you still need.
reason.supercharger_faster: Home charging cannot finish before ready-by; {{site}} is the cheapest billed Supercharger.
reason.wait_offpeak: Wait for off-peak at {{time}} — save {{save}} versus charging now.

aiBuilder.description: Describe the alert you want to receive an advisory text proposal. Review it and manually enter the rule in the standard form before saving; this action does not fill the form, save, or enable an alert.
aiBuilder.title: Draft from natural language

aiConflicts.description: Surface structural overlaps between your alert rule definitions. Review only — Helix never edits, merges, or deletes rules.
aiConflicts.emptyMessage: No structural conflicts found in the current rule set.
aiConflicts.title: Detect cross-rule conflicts

aiTemplate.description: Ask Helix to write a distinctive Tesla-owner notification body from the alert dimensions you already selected — not a bland threshold line. Helix uses the same placeholder catalog as the editor and never saves — Apply copies the draft into the field below, then you click Save.
aiTemplate.emptyHint: Choose a signal or computed metric (and operator) first so Helix can ground the template.
aiTemplate.title: Suggest a message template

aiTuning.description: Review recent firings and propose a typed AlertRule patch. Descriptive replay only — review before saving.
aiTuning.title: Suggest lower-noise tuning

aiCategorize.description: Suggest categories through a separate recent-history request using the vehicle, severity, and rule filters supplied to this panel. The inbox or archive view and exact workspace date bounds do not filter this request; it uses its own lookback window (7 days by default). Review the proposal before applying its rule IDs as an inbox filter; this does not save categories or archive notifications.
aiCategorize.title: Suggest inbox categories

aiSuggestion.description: Ask Helix to recommend ONE quiet-hours window based on the trailing 30 days of your notification cadence. Helix never reads individual notification titles or messages — it consults a per-hour aggregate of non-critical events to find the sparsest interval. Apply the recommendation to seed the form below; you remain in control of the Save button.
aiSuggestion.previewExistingCount: You already have {{count}} quiet-hours window(s) configured.
aiSuggestion.previewInsufficientHistory: Helix had insufficient notification history; this is a conservative default.
aiSuggestion.title: Suggest a quiet-hours window from your notification history

operationalMode.writeBlocked: Return to live mode before making operational changes.

narrative.causeUnavailable: Cause is not established by the available evidence.
narrative.responseUnavailable: No action is recommended from this evidence alone.
narrative.title: Decision narrative
narrative.whyUnavailable: No defensible impact statement is available.

vehicles.batteryCoverageNote: Based on {{covered}} of {{total}} vehicles with a current battery reading.
vehicles.coverageNote: Based on {{covered}} of {{total}} vehicles with a current reading.
vehicles.description: Live connectivity, departure readiness, utilization, software consistency, and service attention are consolidated before vehicle-level detail.
vehicles.evidenceGapDescription: Refresh vehicles without verified battery or software readings before making fleet-wide decisions.
vehicles.lowBatteryDescription: Review charging readiness before the next scheduled departure.

narrative.chargeResponse: Confirm charging plans for vehicles below the departure-readiness threshold.
narrative.connectivityResponse: Verify connectivity before issuing commands to vehicles without live state.
narrative.coverageLimitation: Fleet-wide conclusions are limited because one or more vehicles lack verified current state, battery, or software evidence.
narrative.evidenceGapResponse: Refresh vehicles without verified state, battery, or software evidence before making fleet-wide readiness decisions.
narrative.evidenceLimit: Supporting evidence is limited to four vehicle snapshots and two urgent work orders.
narrative.liveBasis: Live state resolved for {{online}} of {{total}} registered vehicles.
narrative.liveMethod: Resolves current state independently for every registered vehicle.
narrative.monitorResponse: No immediate fleet response is indicated; continue monitoring readiness and service status.
narrative.readyImpact: Verified live state and service status support fleet dispatch decisions; unavailable evidence remains explicitly excluded.

aiSuggestions.description: Get a short plain-language suggestion for lower-consumption habits and route choices grounded in your own historical route data — the dominant route, its kWh/100mi figure, a comparison across your other routes, and one or two concrete, non-mutating ideas you can try yourself.
aiSuggestions.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to generate route-efficiency suggestions.
aiSuggestions.title: Route-efficiency suggestions

aiExplainer.description: Ask Helix to explain the safety-related TeslaSync settings on this page in plain English. Helix only reads the typed envelope of canonical setting values (booleans, enum strings, HH:MM times) — it never reads notification titles, vehicle names, or any other PII, and it never proposes or changes a setting. Use the controls below to update a value yourself; Helix only narrates.
aiExplainer.title: Explain my safety settings

savedViews.makeDefault: Apply automatically when I open this page
savedViews.name: Name
savedViews.title: Saved views

aiSearch.description: Describe what you are looking for and the assistant will surface drives, charging sessions, and alerts that match — citing each entity by name.
aiSearch.title: Search with natural language

aiTripPostcard.description: Ask Helix to draft a propose-only image prompt and preview spec for the selected trip's share card. Helix only sees the redacted trip context (distance, duration, drive count, vehicle name) — never raw coordinates or street addresses. The draft is never published automatically; review it here, then use the existing Share button on the trip to publish a static share card.
aiTripPostcard.noTripHint: Pick a trip from the list above to enable Helix.
aiTripPostcard.title: Draft a Helix share-card image

aiNarration.description: Ask Helix to walk through your firmware update history — the current version, the install cadence, and the headline release-note themes. The narrator quotes only the deterministic update events your vehicle reported plus public Tesla release notes for the versions you have installed; it never invents firmware versions or claims features your installed build does not have.
aiNarration.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle above to enable Helix.
aiNarration.title: Summarize my software update history

l1.desc: Read from the in-process SignalStore (hot path, freshest).

l2.desc: Read from Redis cross-pod cache (legacy entry; freshness unknown).

stale.desc: Redis-backed value older than the 2-minute freshness window.
stale.label: Stale

aiNarrator.description: Get a 3-6 sentence factual narration of the current vehicle FSM transition trace. The narrator reads only the deterministic FSM envelope (vehicle id, window bounds, per-FSM-name counts, per-edge counts, flap count, transition stream) — VINs, coordinates, place names, IPs, and personal identifiers are redacted before the message reaches the provider. The narration is informational; the transition table, state diagram, and FSM health panel above remain the canonical raw view.
aiNarrator.emptyHint: Select a vehicle and a valid time window first.
aiNarrator.title: Helix FSM narrator

aiNarration.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic operating-cost evidence below. Lifetime equivalent gas cost is derived from positive-drive distance, configured gas price per unit, and comparison MPG; only monthly equivalent gas rows estimate distance from recorded-cost charging energy. The layer also discloses the positive-cost charging filter, the flat $50-per-modeled-month maintenance heuristic, and the excluded ownership costs.
aiNarration.noVehicleHint: Pick a vehicle above to enable Helix.
aiNarration.title: Explain my lifetime operating cost

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain how outside ambient temperature affects this vehicle's efficiency — which temperature bucket runs most efficiently, how cold-weather months compare with mild-weather months, and what the seasonal pattern in the chart implies. The bucket and monthly numbers are the same the chart below shows; the narrator only explains them and is honest that these are descriptive aggregates of recent drives, not a forecast.
aiNarrative.emptyHint: Select a vehicle to narrate its temperature impact.
aiNarrative.title: Narrate the cabin-temperature impact

timeMachine.subtitle: Scrub the DVR of your car's mind — reconstruct every signal at any past instant
timeMachine.title: Vehicle time machine

aiTrendReasoning.description: Ask Helix to explain the recent 30-day trend in this vehicle's four corner tire pressures — which tires are trending up, down, or stable, the most likely deterministic driver of any deviation (cold-weather correlation, all-tires-trending suggesting weather rather than puncture, single-corner slow-leak signature), and any actionable threshold crossing. The per-corner pressures and thresholds are the same the gauges below show; the narrator only explains them and is honest that the slope is a descriptive linear extrapolation, not a forecast.
aiTrendReasoning.title: Narrate the 30-day tire-pressure trend

aiSuggestName.description: Get a short, propose-only name suggestion grounded in this trip’s route context (start and end places, drive count, distance, time window). The suggestion is never saved automatically — review the proposed name in the panel and click Save to apply it.
aiSuggestName.title: Suggest a trip name

aiNarrative.description: Ask Helix to explain the deterministic vampire-drain signal — the recent average / worst idle-drain rate, the most-correlated per-event driver (Sentry, climate, long park), and whether the recent rate is in line with the typical fleet. The numbers are the same the cards below show; the narrator only explains them and surfaces the inference's correlational nature honestly.
aiNarrative.title: Explain the recent vampire drain

watchFaceNL.description: Ask Helix a glance-style natural-language question about your vehicle right now — battery, range, charging, locks, climate, recent alerts.
